CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting - Conference Room: 2nd Floor
  Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. 1st St., Alhambra, CA 91801

June 27, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  Absent: None
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

C.  CONSENT AGENDA

  All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design
  Review Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the
  Discussion Agenda.

  ITEM 1: 2221 Hitchcock Drive

  ITEM 2: 1211 East Valley Boulevard

  ITEM 3: 508 North Second Street

  MOTION:
  o Board Member Daninger moved to approve the consent agenda.
  o The second was by Board Member Hernandez.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  ITEM 4: 320 North Third Street

  •  Request: A new one-story single-family residence and a one-story addition to an
  existing single-family residence.

  •  Applicant: Maggie Thai, Fortress Development Inc.

  1
   •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the
  digital materials board shall be updated to accurately depict the use of asphalt
  shingles for the proposed roofs as well as the proposed fiber cement lap siding.

  •  Discussion:
  The applicant was present, had no comments and the staff report was given.

  Board Member Tsai recused himself due to living within the defined radius for
  recusal.

  Board Member Hernandez confirmed the staff recommendation and confirmed that
  there were no colored elevations submitted.

  The roof material was discussed as being inconsistent with the proposed craftsman
  style.

  Board Member Daninger questioned the drawing accuracy of the elevations as the
  west and south elevations as not consistent. The DRB stated that the west elevation
  should be corrected to match the condition shown on the south elevation and that the
  design be updated as necessary.

MOTION:
  o Board Member Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The west elevation shall be corrected to match the condition shown
  on the south elevation; 2) The roof shall be changed to asphalt composition
  shingle; 3) The materials board shall be updated according to the design changes;
  4) Any MWELO required landscape documents shall be provided at the time of
  building plan check submittal; and 5) Design changes shall be confirmed with
  DRB Staff prior to building plan check submittal.
  o The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Tsai

ITEM 5: 204 Palatine Drive

  •  Request: A new two-story single-family residence with a detached garage on a vacant
  lot.

  •  Applicant: David Angelo, David Angelo & Associates

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that
  MWELO-compliant landscape documents be submitted at the time of building plan
  check submittal.

  2
   •  Discussion:
  The applicant was present and stated that he has been in the planning process with
  the City for 4 years.

  Board Member Hernandez questioned the entry to the project and the appropriate
  designations of the since there is no north arrow on the drawings.

  Board Member Udani confirmed that that AC condenser is visible from the street and
  this issue should be resolved. The applicant and owner stated that they are amenable
  to moving the unit to a location not visible from the street.

  Board Member Tsai questioned if the glass railing shown has a cap and if so, what
  material is being used. The photo provided shows a stainless cap. The designer stated
  that it was not decided but the material will be consistent with the house design.

  Board Member Hernandez questioned the consistency of exterior materials at the
  areas with CMU (i.e. split face and precision) at the detached garage. The designer
  stated that it would be stucco over concrete block as stated in the materials board. It
  was stated that the elevations should be accurately documented.

MOTION:
  o Board Member Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following
  conditions: 1) The AC condenser unit shall be moved so it is not visible from
  Palatine; 2) The cap of the glass railing shall be complementary to the materials
  of the house; 3) The documentation shall be updated to accurately show stucco
  over CMU at the detached garage; 4) Any MWELO required landscape
  documentation shall be provided prior to building plan check submittal; and 5)
  All changes shall be reviewed by DRB Staff prior to building plan check
  submittal.
  o The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 6: 1800 South Marguerita Avenue

  •  Request: A new 2,579 square foot two-story single-family residence with an attached
  three-car garage.

  •  Applicant: Yang Wang, Yang Architect Inc.

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following
  conditions: 1. The applicant shall resolve issues of building modulation and scale
  with the City Architect prior to building plan check submittal; 2. A more complete

  3
   landscape design and any MWELO-related documents shall be provided for review;
  and 3. If consensus is not reached with the City Architect, the applicant shall return
  to the Design Review Board under the same application.

  •  Discussion:
  The designer stated that she has now provided color elevations and a revised site wall
  design (stucco over CMU) that is more consistent with the architectural style.

  Board Member Tsai stated that although the design has improved the roof eaves are
  too minimal. He also stated that the massing of the house was without adequate
  setback. A change to the roof and the use of corbels could also improve the scale of
  the elevations.

  Board Member Hernandez stated that she too would like to see a deeper eave with
  corbels. The roofline can be improved to adequately integrate with the balcony.

  Board Member Udani restated that the building mass is large but the windows are
  small in in contrast. The fenestration seems not to match the overall building scale.
  This was a concurrence amongst the board members.

  There was ongoing discussion regarding the lack of modulation and detail. City
  Architect Abe stated that proposal appears to be designed in a linear fashion where
  the floor plan is completed first and the elevations are simply a result of the floor
  plan. A better design approach would be for the design to be iterative so that one
  decision relates to the next.

  Board Member Hernandez stated that the roof needs to be reworked for accuracy, for
  modulation and for better integration at the balcony.

  MOTION:
  o Board Member Daninger moved to continue the application.
  o The second was by Board Member Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

E.  PUBLIC COMMENTS:

  •  City Architect Abe stated that this is the last DRB meeting for his consulting
  company Media Portfolio and the new City Architect position will be managed by
  the firm Onyx Architects.

  •  The representatives from Onyx, Steve Kuchenski and Eric Martinez, were present
  and introduced themselves to the DRB.

  4
 F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on July 11, 2023.

  MOTION:

  o Board Member Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30 P.M.
  o The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  o The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

  _____________________
  Ankit Udani
  Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
